integrity: A self-contained proof and standalone finite reproducibility checker are supplied; computational checks do not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only rank-preserving, length-exactly-two labelled free-semigroup endomorphisms; not a classification of higher-length images, and no independence or exhaustive bibliographic uniqueness is asserted.
title: Hamiltonian irreducibility and exponential rarity of length-two free-semigroup endomorphisms
